title: [Bug][ComboV2] Failed bolus error when bolus actually succeded
symptom: When issuing a bolus via the insulin dialog, the pump vibrates and the bolus finishes, but a 'bolus failed' dialog pops up even though the bolus actually succeeded. The main screen shows 'connecting for XXs' while the driver reconnects and reads the bolus.
cause: The issue is related to Bluetooth connectivity between the phone and pump. The driver lost connection during the bolus, and after reconnecting and reading the bolus, the failed bolus alarm is triggered incorrectly. A user speculates it started after changes in dev related to 'RunningMode' around April, and another notes it started after version 3.3.
evidence_quote: I see, it's related con BT connectivity. Unfortunately there is nothing we can do more. AAPS behave correctly: recovered from failed connection and read history the issue is between phone and pump
